sourceEvidence.text: Belong developed from an intensive be- and an older longen associated with going along with or pertaining to something. Ownership and membership meanings developed in the same history. A deeper connection with the adjective long is uncertain; be long meaning have great length is not a reliable literal explanation of modern belong.
